summary.text: Heidi Sinsley is the Democratic candidate for the North Carolina House of Representatives, District 69, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Her campaign website describes her as an attorney and community advocate.

paragraphs.text: Sinsley's campaign website says she is the daughter of an engineer and a stay-at-home mother and a graduate of public schools.
It says her father was diagnosed with Huntington's disease during her teenage years and was labeled uninsurable, an experience it describes as inspiring her work on healthcare access.
The site lists national security, healthcare, cost of living and education as the issues of her campaign.
